classification: Additive independently pinned verifier snapshot and offline CLI; strict unsigned coverage diagnostic v2 and provider metadata validation
receiptImpact: No signed schema, EIP-712 field order, profile, key, registry release, historical source-group map or coverage policy ID is rewritten. verify-insight-receipt 0.3.0 adds an optional exact-byte SHA-256 pinned registry parser and offline CLI, preserves v1-v5 cryptographic layouts and rejects malformed pair UIDs without throwing. Signed strict coverage input conversion requires explicit quorum provenance and rejects invalid provider ages. Unsigned coverage diagnostics identify schema insight.coverage-diagnostic.v2, count only classified exact-scope nonduplicate observations, and compute freshness from declared source time provenance and retrieval time. Unknown groups are null and cannot count toward independent groups. Diagnostics remain unsigned and are not a safety or SLA claim.
activationRule: The new snapshot API and CLI require explicit consumer opt-in and an independently reviewed hash pin. This code release does not change any partner activation, API issuance exception, production attester or partner trust pin. Unsigned diagnostic consumers must branch on schema v2 and handle null unclassified groups. npm publication, mainline CI deployment and any partner live run are separate verified operations; this record does not claim they occurred.
